cost.note: The City Corporation-added service fee is explicitly zero beyond statutory property tax. Do not present the whole transaction as fee-free: the policy says bank or payment-gateway charges may exist, and no reviewed official route states their amount or an actionable schedule.

documents.note: The reviewed service-details route does not identify a document that the citizen must submit, provide, upload, produce, or attach.

eligibility.note: The actionable rule is that the online service is for property owners within Bengaluru City Corporation limits.

time.note: The reviewed service-details route touches assessment-year timing but no actionable duration, deadline, processing period, or service-level target is captured.

owner.note: The reviewed route names Bengaluru City Corporations/GBA and a head-office contact topic, but no claim identifies the office or operational role that holds or decides a case.

after-submission.note: After payment, the published procedure says the citizen receives real-time payment confirmation and a generated receipt.
